review.sourceReading: The source description labels this recording hǎochī (好吃), a male voice from Beijing, recorded 2006-10-29.
review.acousticInspection: Praat autocorrelation at 10 ms steps, 60–400 Hz: median F0 in successive 100 ms windows from 0.2 s is 114.1, 102.1, 98.8, 103.3 Hz. The first voiced region falls and remains low; the second voiced region is about 139–142 Hz. This supports the intended half-third-tone context but is not a phonetic transcription or a quality guarantee.
review.listening: Not performed. Source identification, decoding and acoustic inspection do not establish pronunciation naturalness by listening.

review.sourceReading: The source description labels this recording zhǔnbèi (准备), a male voice from Beijing, recorded 2006-10-29.
review.acousticInspection: Praat autocorrelation at 10 ms steps, 60–500 Hz: Median F0 in successive 100 ms windows from 0.2 s is 188.2, 181.7, 176.9, 183.5 Hz; the first voiced region stays relatively level with a small fall. This is not a phonetic transcription or a quality guarantee.

sourceMetadata.description: Original Shtooka FLAC redistributed in Free Cultural Works Mandarin Audio Pack 1.0.0 by Trevor L. Davis; the pack filename applies tone sandhi, while its embedded pinyin retains dictionary tones.
sourceMetadata.audioMatch: Original FLAC and the shipped MP3 decode to 27563 mono samples at 22050 Hz; waveform Pearson correlation is 0.984674. This links the MP3 to the tagged source recording, without judging pronunciation.

review.sourceReading: The original FLAC metadata labels this recording 准许, zhǔnxǔ, by Yue Tan, recorded 2009-07-10. Written tones remain third tone on both syllables. The matching audio-cmn MP3 is distributed here.
review.acousticInspection: Praat autocorrelation at 10 ms steps, 60–500 Hz: Median F0 in successive 100 ms windows from 0.3 s is 227.5, 218.8, 274.3 Hz. The first voiced region rises after a short initial dip, supporting sandhi on the first syllable. Tracking in the second syllable includes unvoiced gaps and octave errors; no exact second-syllable contour is claimed. This is not a phonetic transcription or a quality guarantee.
review.listening: Not performed. Source identification, decoding and acoustic inspection do not establish pronunciation naturalness by listening.
